title: Unit tests for vault_io.py: 20+ invariants anchored to vault_io_spec.md
objective: Author pytest unit tests under etl4/tests/test_vault_io.py that exercise every public method of etl4/vault/vault_io.py (T-05) at the function level, independent of the smoke script. Anchors to the invariants in vault_io_spec.md section 5 and acceptance criteria in section 9.
unblocks: T-08 developer handoff (unit suite becomes the regression guard)

acceptance_criteria.statement: Full suite pytest etl4/tests/ -q shows no regression attributable to T-06
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 92 tests collected, 91 passed, 1 failed. The single failure test_pipeline.py::test_matrix_csv_written_after_every_cell is caused by pre-existing uncommitted modifications to etl4/bench/run_matrix.py (status M at task start); verified by stashing -u and re-running -> suite is 49/0/0 without the uncommitted run_matrix.py diff. Not a T-06 regression.

acceptance_criteria.statement: All filesystem state under tmp_path; data/silver/vault/ never touched
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Every write-side test accepts tmp_path fixture; no bare SILVER_VAULT_ROOT writes in the test file.

acceptance_criteria.statement: No pyarrow mocks; real parquet writer/reader exercised against tmp_path
acceptance_criteria.evidence: pq.write_table / pq.read_table / pq.ParquetFile called directly; no unittest.mock usage.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Windows cp1252-safe stdout in test prints
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Source contains no U+2192 arrow, U+2014 em-dash, U+2013 en-dash.
git status shows only etl4/tests/test_vault_io.py and the task JSON as new; etl4/vault/vault_io.py untouched.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Concurrent-write survivor invariant verified at filesystem level (not mocked)
acceptance_criteria.evidence: test_concurrent_write_to_same_ym_single_survivor uses ThreadPoolExecutor; post-condition asserts exactly one part.parquet and zero .tmp artefacts.

commands_run.note: 91 passed, 1 failed. The failing test (test_matrix_csv_written_after_every_cell) is independent of vault_io; traced to the uncommitted run_matrix.py diff that was present at task start. Confirmed by stash+pop isolation.

commands_run.cmd: git stash -u; pytest etl4/tests/test_pipeline.py::test_matrix_csv_written_after_every_cell -v; git stash pop
commands_run.note: Test passes without the uncommitted run_matrix.py changes -- confirms pre-existing status.

invariants_covered: AC 2(a) round-trip preserves icao24 string dtype
AC 2(b) non-existent ym returns empty with no columns
AC 2(d) monolithic fallback when no ym= dirs
AC 2(e) columns= pushdown returns only requested columns
AC 3(a) atomic write (no stray .tmp after completion)
AC 4   row_count equals sum of pq.ParquetFile().metadata.num_rows
AC 5   list_ym returns [] on empty / monolith-only tables
AC 6   ym helpers (filename / date / epoch / frame / path)
vault_io_spec 5.3 empty table returns bare pd.DataFrame (no FileNotFoundError)
vault_io_spec 6 Spark-shard glob inside ym= dir
write_partition ym regex (YYYY-MM or SYN-<hex>); malformed inputs raise ValueError
notes: Tests complement rather than duplicate t05_vault_io_smoke.py: that is a single long script that aborts on first failure; this test file is 43 parametrised pytest functions that report every failure independently. Test counts: 43 added (target was >=15). Pre-existing suite was 49; new total under this file alone is 49 + 43 = 92 (confirmed by pytest collection). The single failing test (test_matrix_csv_written_after_every_cell) is owned by whoever is working on etl4/bench/run_matrix.py and is OUT OF T-06 SCOPE -- flagged to orchestrator.
